records.question: How many of the DNA extractions were positive by PCR amplification for bacterial community DNA (16S rDNA genes)?
records.ground_truth_answer: Of the 380 extractions, 155 mucus samples and 129 tissue samples (284 combined) were positive by PCR amplification for bacterial community DNA (16S rDNA genes).
ground_truth_chunks: That makes for a total of 376 DNA extractions (mucus + tissue samples), plus 4 water controls (Sept 04 sample set to confirm mucus signal was not background water) = 380 DNA extractions.

Of those 380 extractions, 155 mucus samples and 129 tissue samples (284 combined) were positive by PCR amplification for bacterial community DNA (16S rDNA genes). Those 284 samples are being analyzed by DGGE (denaturing gel gradient electrophoresis) right now, so that we can compare bacterial community 'fingerprints' between (1) Individuals of the same coral species, (2) Different coral genera and species, (3) Pool 300 and Pool 400, and (4) mucus and tissue. This will take a couple of months to run all the gels and use the software to interpret the patterns.
